mechanics.title: Schematic rendering
mechanics.description: Shows a schematic as an overlay with render layers and per-placement configuration.

mechanics.title: Tool item and area selection
mechanics.description: A tool item (default: stick) with several tool modes selects areas and copies, pastes or deletes them.

mechanics.title: Schematic verifier
mechanics.description: Compares the built world to the schematic and lists missing or wrong blocks.

mechanics.title: Easy Place
mechanics.description: Optional feature that may be flagged by anti-cheat and get you banned on some servers; check server rules first.

qol: Rendering does not currently work properly with shaders on 1.21.3+; disable shaders while using schematic rendering
commands_and_keybinds: Page Up/Down: change selected render layer
Ctrl+scroll with tool: cycle tool mode
Alt+scroll with tool: nudge placement or selection
getting_started: Press M, open Load Schematics and pick a file, then place it with the tool item or from Schematic Placements.
editor_notes: Fork by sakura-ryoko. Requires MaLiLib. Keys differ on non-QWERTY layouts.
name: Litematica
summary: Client-side schematic mod for builders. Load or create schematics, render them as ghost blocks in the world, verify your build against them, and copy, paste or edit areas. It has no built-in printer.
